This is a demo of adding, editing and deleting in a modal dialog, the same in Wicket, React and Svelte.
  • The Wicket tab uses the Modal of ui-components, Wicket's ModalDialog in the colors of the theme of the page: Add member and Edit open the form of a member in it, Delete asks to confirm. Cancel and Save, made by button factories, are in the footer, on the right. Saving repaints the team through Ajax
  • The × in the top right corner closes the dialog, as Escape and Cancel do. A click on the dimmed page around it closes it too, an option on in this demo
  • Change a field, then try to close the dialog: it asks whether to discard the changes first, a function the dialog asks before it closes
  • Drag the title to move the dialog; double-click it to fold the dialog to its title, and again to unfold it, in the browser alone. Both can be turned off
  • While it is open the focus stays in it, Tab and Shift+Tab going round its fields and buttons, and when it closes the focus goes back to the button that opened it
  • The form is validated as Wicket validates it: the name and the email required, the email an address. Try saving it empty

The React and Svelte tabs use the Modal of @antilia/react and @antilia/svelte: the same markup, style sheet and behaviors, from the core's ModalDialog. They add, edit and delete the same team, kept in your session, through the mounted resource /api/team, which validates with the messages of the Wicket form: a member changed in one tab shows in the others once they load the team again.
